title: The classic strawberry test
prompt: How many times does the letter R appear in the word 'strawberry'? Answer with just the number.

title: Random number consistency check
prompt: Give me one random whole number between 0 and 100. Just the number, nothing else.

title: Fun fact quality
prompt: Tell me one surprising fun fact about octopuses that most people don't know. Two sentences max.

title: Simple logic riddle
prompt: A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 die. How many sheep are left? Explain your reasoning in one sentence.

title: Explain like I'm five
prompt: Explain what a large language model is to a curious 5-year-old, in 3 sentences or less.

title: Quick joke / personality check
prompt: Tell me a short, original joke about debugging code.

title: Original mini-poem (no copyrighted lyrics/poems involved)
prompt: Write an original 3-line haiku about coding in Budapest at night.

title: Would-you-rather reasoning
prompt: Would you rather fight one horse-sized duck or a hundred duck-sized horses? Give a one-sentence tactical justification.

title: Which is larger: 9.11 or 9.9?
prompt: Which is larger: 9.11 or 9.9? Answer with just the larger number.
